reviews.comment: Dr. K was a great thermo prof. His lectures were good and he provided a ton of practice problems and worked them out. He also organized a tour of the power plant that was super unique. He is a very fair grader and cares that his students learn.

Love taking his class. Great lecture material and quizzes keep you up-to-date. Homework is fair, quizzes help you study. Overall great class and important to pay attention build good foundation as a ME. He is decently funny and cares alot ab his research which is inspiring.
While many mentioned that if you do the hws you will be fine on the exams, THIS IS FALSE. He doesn't teach the same manner in that the exams are structured.

Optix for engineers was an interesting topic. Dr. K was an expert in this area. He treats graduate students like how you should treat graduate students. respectful and mature
He is tech savvy and works good with online tools
Exams can be tough with respect to the time frame but he is forgiving and look at everything. 
Projects were great

While I myself did bad in this class, I will say Dr. K is still a great professor. His lectures can be boring though, so do keep that in mind. He assigns a lot of homework, which is pretty time-consuming, but I do think it helps with test performance. If you work through homework problems again when studying for tests, you should probably be fine.

Professor Kulatilaka was a good professor and I really enjoyed his class.  Thermodynamics is a tough subject, but Professor Kulatilaka made it pretty easy to understand.  The exams are difficult but if you review the slides and homework problems you should do fine.  I would recommend taking Professor Kulatilaka if you can.

Great class honestly; lectures were clear, plenty of practice for the exams through example problems and HW, and easy pop quizzes. I felt very prepared for the exams as there was plenty of material similar to the exam problems and class averages were in the mid B's. Although content is difficult, with enough practice an A is very doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Solid choice for thermodynamics. The class is very tough and the homework will take you days to complete, however they are a good indication on what will be on the exam. Nice guy and very clear in lecture notes. The only downside is that there are random pop quizzes that count for a notable part of your grade (only about 5 given)
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The exams are difficult and he is an extremely tough grader. He makes problems more complicated than they really are. He is a nice professor, but does not know how to explain to our level.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. K is a great prof! His lectures and content are VERY well organized, and grading criteria is always clear. His tests aren't too difficult, just redo the HW & examples on your own. Weekly HW, pop quizzes (not many, 9 throughout the semester) on the TopHat app for your phone, and a semester long research paper project.
